newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chesterfield interim net loss HK$4.61 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield interim net loss HK$4.61 mln.

text.p: NOTE - Chesterfield is a knitwear manufacturer.
Net is after an exceptional gain on recovery of an option fee paid for a hotel development and for which full provision has been made in prior year.

In prior periods, the group included the gross proceeds from the sales of marketable securities in the group turnover. During the current period, to better reflect the performance of its operations, the group changed the basis to include the net profit instead of the gross proceeds from the sales of marketable securities in the group turnover. Comparative turnover has been restated to conform with the current period presentation. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6368
